function.name: submit_plan
function.arguments: {"decision": "clarify", "reason": "The request is missing or ambiguous in the following required fields: (1) region_id — \"CAIOS\" is not a supported region; allowed regions are CISO, ERCO, GD, ISNE, MISO, SWPP. (3) cost_shortfall — \"shortfal penalty 20\" is interpretable as 20.0, but confirmation is required. (4) cost_reserve — not stated; the study requires cost_reserve=1.0. (5) rolling_window — not stated; the study requires train_days=730, cal_days=30, test_days=30, rolling_step_days=30. (6) task_type — not explicitly stated; assumed upward_reserve_sizing.
